name: SelectMenuItem
label: Select Menu Item
description: Selects a menu item from the SAP GUI menu bar using a path (e.g., 'System → Log Off').

fields.name: MenuItem
fields.label: Menu Item
fields.description: Path to the menu item using '→' as separator (e.g., 'System → User Profile → Own Data').

fields.name: DelayBefore
fields.label: Delay Before
fields.description: Time to wait before executing the activity, in seconds. Default is 0.2 seconds.

fields.name: DelayAfter
fields.label: Delay After
fields.description: Time to wait after executing the activity, in seconds. Default is 0.3 seconds.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.label: Timeout
fields.description: Maximum time to wait for the operation to complete, in seconds. Default is 30 seconds.

fields.name: AlterDisabledElement
fields.label: Alter disabled element
fields.description: Whether to allow interaction with disabled menu items.

fields.name: ContinueOnError
fields.label: Continue on error
fields.description: Whether to continue execution if this activity fails.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Result of the operation: success or error message.
